Ranked defects

#1 [High] Hugenholtz banked-bowl furniture sits 0.02-0.09 lap (≈85-380 m) before the actual bowl.

Measured: bank lift peaks at s=0.209 (window 0.194-0.224, 3.96 m, sign +). js/circuits/scenery/zandvoort.js:660-661 bankedKerbStrip(0.115-0.185 / 0.120-0.175) ends before 0.194; the SAFER rail, grandstandEx(0.132) (l.321) , duneDeck(0.18) (l.323), fence/recordBarrier(0.11-0.19) (l.668,674) and tyreWall(0.125-0.18) (l.689) are anchored to the same pre-bowl stretch, so the bowl itself (0.194-0.224) has no tilted kerbs or rail. Luyendyk is right (strips 0.885-0.955 around bank 0.897-0.926). Suggested fix: re-anchor to T3 apex 0.2084 (e.g. 0.19-0.23). Mechanism: fractions authored before the start-line rotation, same class as the comment at js/circuits/zandvoort.js:35-43.

#2 [Medium] Elevation is flat except one 8 m crest, contradicting the brief's 'continuous dune undulation'.

Measured py range -0.2..8.0 m; every sample outside 0.53-0.60 is 0.0±0.2 m. Source: js/circuits/zandvoort.js:60 single elevations entry {s:0.56, halfM:300, rise:8}. Terrain dunes are scenery only (scenery l.82-134), so the road never rises over them. Suggested fix: add 2-4 low (1-3 m) entries; confirm heights against a dated source first (not sourced here).

#3 [Medium] Built lap is 4216 m versus 4257 m trace and 4259 m real (-1.0%).

Measured total 4216.04 m, n=1054 (verify-track context); path.len 4257 (js/circuits/zandvoort.js:~74); lengthKm 4.3 (l.28). Probably smoothing of the OSM trace. Not a fix target alone; report to the parent.

#4 [Low] Corner naming inconsistent across comments.

js/circuits/zandvoort.js:52 labels T11 (apex 0.7558) 'Hans Ernst chicane' while l.56 labels racing arc 0.075-0.102 'Hans Ernst'. One of the two is wrong; only the curated turn list (l.72) is authoritative. Names beyond Tarzan, Hugenholtz, Mastersbocht, Luyendyk were not verified.

#5 [Low] Night race lighting is not authored: night:false and furniture lamp:'none', so 'night' is just a black sky with emissive lamp heads.

js/circuits/zandvoort.js:26,68; lamps are scenery boxes at js/circuits/scenery/zandvoort.js:734-754 (every 35 nodes, both sides, ~60 poles). Frames 30-36 show warm pools on sand but unlit stands. Zandvoort is a day circuit, so acceptable; flag only because the survey asked.

#6 [Low] Sea 'peek' boxes and groundPlane water read as rectangular ponds, not sea.

scenery:634-652 nine seaCol boxes 42-52 m wide, 2.2-2.8 m high at 132-165 m out, plus 2 groundPlanes at 175/185 m; visible as a flat blue slab in frames 02, 04, 16. The real North Sea bands (l.33-41, 235-385 m out) are mostly hidden behind dunes. Suggested fix: lower/lengthen boxes or drop them where the band shows.

#8 [Medium] Overcast frames are visually indistinguishable from dry day.

Frames 28-29 (orbit 0.17, 0.50) show a clear blue sky and hard sun, while storm, rain and fog darken the scene. Engine-side, not a circuit defect: the cause was not traced (look at the overcast preset in js/race/weather-arc.js / js/lighting/atmosphere.js). Report to the lighting owner; no circuit change suggested.

#7 [Low] Props that the engine suppressed or the audit tolerates.

Measured: 66 hedge + 6 tree guard drops (verify-track), ground-audit buried 4 / flatCoplanar 7 / coplanar 1 (all within baseline). Not visible in frames reviewed.
